## Checklist

- [ ] `source` is pinned to a tag or commit (and `sha256` given for a single file)
- [ ] `version` matches in the entry, `pyproject.toml` and `ewald-plugin.toml`
- [ ] `index.json` rebuilt
- [ ] Paths, encodings and line endings work on Windows, macOS and Linux
- [ ] Nothing private: no keys, passwords, home or internal paths
